highlights: Capture sharper details and clearer images with 2K (3MP) resolution, ensuring nothing goes unnoticed whether it’s day or night.
The FOV102° lens offers wide-angle surveillance, covering more of your room with a single device—perfect for living rooms, bedrooms, or offices.
Built-in AI-powered human detection intelligently distinguishes human activity from movement by pets or other objects, reducing false alarms and focusing only on what’s important.
Remotely control the camera to monitor every corner. With a 360° horizontal and 90° vertical rotation, blind spots are virtually eliminated.
Operates reliably in a range of conditions, withstanding temperatures from -10°C to 40°C, making it suitable for year-round use indoors.
Supports Micro SD/TF cards up to 256GB, providing ample space to store video footage without requiring a cloud subscription. Ideal for continuous or motion-triggered recording.
